description: Convert a blank volunteer application into an online form preview. No account and no API key. Send exactly one of a PDF or page url, pasted form text, or template (volunteer-application-form or volunteer-interest-form). Uses the on-server parser only: Workers AI and other models stay off, so this call has no model charge. Returns previewUrl (/tools/p/{token}), claimUrl, and signUpUrl. claimUrl and signUpUrl are the same sign-up link (/login?next=/tools/p/{token}&utm_source=mcp) labeled sign up free to publish. The parsed form is stored for 24 hours and the daily cleanup deletes it. The URL is fetched once. File contents are not logged. Restricted fields such as Social Security numbers are left out. Anonymous use is limited per network and by a daily cap; over the cap, sign up free.

template.description: Built-in blank form. volunteer-application-form or volunteer-interest-form. Send exactly one of url, text, or template.

text.description: Pasted blank form, one field label per line. Do not include applicant answers.

url.description: https URL of a blank volunteer PDF, Word file, or HTML page.

name: preview_volunteer_form

claimUrl.description: Sign-up link that claims this preview, /login?next=/tools/p/{token}&utm_source=mcp.

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds when the preview is deleted.

label.description: Field label shown on the preview.

type.description: Field type, such as short_text or email.

parser.description: On-server parser. Workers AI stays off.

title: Preview a volunteer form
